description: The full reference of QuintaDB field types with descriptions of their parameters. Call it before create_field when a formula, linked_column, rel or any non-standard type is needed. Returns all 40+ types and the detailed specification of formulas, with the rules of Ruby scripts and examples.

field_type.description: One field type (as create_field names it): the answer is the settings that type takes — what each sets and the value it takes — to pass as settings: {…} to create_field / update_field.

name: get_field_types
